note: Live string_id registry of HaloSimulation_tag_release.dll (mapping table at RVA 0x013574C0). 2,678 builtin ids are present at the frontend; the rest register as tags load, so this set is a lower bound for other missions. Entries are [id, name]; ids below 0x10000 with no set bits are the sequential registrations (1068 + n), the builtin 2,678 carry set bits in the high half.
